paper_id: Dong et al. - 2010 - Distributed Coverage in Wireless Ad Hoc and Sensor Networks by Topological Graph Approaches
title: Distributed Coverage in Wireless Ad Hoc and Sensor Networks by Topological Graph Approaches
motivation: 现有覆盖调度方法依赖精确位置信息或距离测量,在资源受限网络中难以获取
problem_framing: 提出τ-confine coverage定义,用图论框架实现仅基于连通性信息的可配置覆盖粒度
key_insight: 边界 cycle 的 τ-partitionability 可替代 homology group 作为覆盖充分条件,从而松弛 Ghrist 方法的限制
method_signature: 基于 cycle-partition 的分布式覆盖算法,通过 void preserving transformation 删除冗余节点
evaluation_criteria: 覆盖集大小、相比 HGC 节省节点数、实际 trace 拓扑实验
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: homology group 条件过强,导致全覆盖网络被误判为有洞;Ghrist 方法只能处理三角形,造成不必要浪费
thinking_moves: 识别已有方法(Ghrist)的三大局限:集中计算、假阳性、三角形约束
从 algebraic topology 重新 frame 到 graph theory
放松 homology criterion 强度,保持充分性保证
以 mobius band 反例展示 homology 方法失效而 cycle-partition 方法有效
工程上用 MIS 分布式删除节点实现稀疏覆盖集
extraction_notes: Paper is conference submission with no explicit venue info; Yunhao Liu is co-author (not first/corresponding)
